name: context-gardener
description: Audit, reconcile, and prune the context documents an AI assistant loads (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md, memory, profile docs). Finds contradictions, stale claims, broken references, filename-vs-content drift, and two subtler failure modes; reports findings ranked by how badly each could mislead; stages fixes on a reviewable duplicate and applies to live only on your instruction. Runs read-only on a loop.
